svg.title: Response across ten habitat classes
svg.desc: Can Figurestead show ten categorical distributions with varied centers and spreads while keeping the categorical structure, individual observations, summaries, and axis labels readable at useful compact sizes? Deterministic synthetic observations; horizontal rules show per-category medians. Deterministic synthetic observations; horizontal rules show per-category medians.
